newsitem.title: USA: Wheelchair-bound man saves woman from drowning.
newsitem.headline: Wheelchair-bound man saves woman from drowning.

text.p: A wheelchair-bound man dived into a swimming pool and saved a drowning woman by hauling her up from the bottom, hospital officials said on Wednesday.

Orain Williams, 20, was curled up in a ball in eight feet (2.4 m) of water Tuesday when Darrell Colson, a paraplegic who normally swims in the same apartment house pool for exercise, heard someone cry for help, wheeled to the water's edge and dived in.
He grabbed Williams by the arm and pulled her to the surface. Colson's girlfriend arrived to help haul the woman out of the pool and apply life-saving techniques, police said.
William was in critical condition on Wednesday, hospital officials said.
